title: GSD — Operating Model
summary: Process contract defining how work is run in the sports-store-deployments repo: the five-stage GSD loop, branching, PR gates, and scope guards.
scope: GSD loop (research, instructions, execution, verification, repo-feedback)
gsd/ note folders and file naming
docs-task scope guards (helm/, terraform, application code)
repo layout (manifests, configmaps, secrets, mongodb, service dirs)
notes: MANIFEST_TYPE=SPEC applied as authoritative; heuristics alone would have leaned DOC (prose process guide) since there are no API/schema contracts. Treated as a process specification with binding rules: (1) docs before changes, (2) one concern per branch/PR, (3) namespace 'sports-store' is fixed and must not be renamed, (4) no secret values in git — references only, (5) main is PR-gated with >=1 approval, (6) STATUS.md and gsd/ notes updated before opening a PR, (7) no autonomous process-affecting or cross-repo PRs without owner coordination, (8) docs tasks must not touch helm/, terraform, or application code. This file holds no live status; live state is in STATUS.md. Source hash is a deterministic placeholder — no shell available to compute SHA-256.
